class.value: preinsulated pipes for district heating and cooling

generalComment.value:
Preinsulated bonded TwinPipe 2 x 60.3/ 200 – conti method – is a preinsulated pipe with 2 media steel pipes diam. 60.3 mm and casing pipe (200 mm). Length of product – 12 meters. 

Conti TwinPipe (axial) is a complete transmission and distribution system for district heating. Using TwinPipe for district heating pipelines systems can lead to significant savings in terms of heat loss and CO2 emissions, as well as investment and operating costs. 

In the axial conti process pipes are made by casting the insulation onto the service pipes in a moving mould, after which the casing is extruded onto the insulation. The production takes place in continuous process. An effective diffusion barrier foil, preventing diffusion of insulating gases is embedded between the insulation and the casing. Consequently, continuously produced pipes with diffusion barrier foil do not age in relation to heat loss property.

Vorgedämmtes, verklebtes TwinPipe 2 x 60,3/200 – Conti-Verfahren – ist
ein vorisoliertes Rohr mit 2 Medienstahlrohren Durchm. 60,3 mm
und Mantelrohr (200 mm). Produktlänge – 12 Meter.
Conti TwinPipe (axial) ist ein komplettes Getriebe und
Verteilungssystem für Fernwärme. Verwendung von TwinPipe für
Fernwärmeleitungssysteme können zu erheblichen Einsparungen führen
in Bezug auf Wärmeverluste und CO2-Emissionen sowie Investitionen
und Betriebskosten.
Beim Axialkonti-Verfahren werden Rohre durch Gießen hergestellt
Anschließend wird in einer beweglichen Form die Isolierung auf die Anschlussrohre aufgebracht
Das Gehäuse wird auf die Isolierung extrudiert. Die Produktion dauert
im kontinuierlichen Prozess erfolgen. Eine wirksame Diffusionssperrfolie,
Dazwischen ist ein Isoliergas eingebettet, das die Diffusion von Isoliergasen verhindert
die Isolierung und das Gehäuse. Folglich kontinuierlich
Hergestellte Rohre mit Diffusionssperrfolie altern nicht
zu Wärmeverlusten.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
LOGSTOR TwinPipe pre-insulated pipes are a pipe-in-pipe assembly with a composite structure consisting of: - two steel service pipes or steel compensator, - thermal insulation made of rigid polyurethane foam (PUR) with a porous structure, light yellow in color, foamed with the use of cyclopentane, - outer jacket made of polyethylene (PE-HD), made directly in the continuous production process of pre-insulated pipes or made of a pipe produced in a separate production process, black (with or without a diffusion barrier layer). "Axial conti" method - in which thermal insulation of the pipe is made in one process line (by applying successive layers of mixed foam components to the carrier pipe placed in a movable form) and the protective coat is pressed onto the ready insulation; the method is used for the production of LOGSTOR pipes with a casing diameter of DC 90 ÷ 315 mm; 
Technical data: 
Axial continuous production method:

Straight TwinPipe
Diameter of carrier pipe: 60.3 mmSteel carrier pipe
Insulation serie 1
With a diffusion barrier which ensures that the insulation property is kept constant over life time
Lambda value 50: 0.023 W/mK

Steel pipe: Longitudinally or spiral welded P235GH according to EN10217-2
Insulation: Polyurethane foam; Properties: Minimum as required in EN 253
Blowing agent: Cyclopentane
Outer casing: Polyethylene, HDPE, bimodal (Minimum PE 80, ISO 12162); Properties: Minimum as required in EN 253.
All parts are fully weldable within the melt flow index: MFR variation ≤ 0.5 g/10 min. Thermal stability: Oxydation induction time (OIT): > 20 min. at 210° C.
Surveillance system: Wires: 1.5 mm2 copper wires (one is tinned). The embedded copper wires are the backbone of the electronic surveillance systems which is available for most of our pipe systems.

Vorisolierte LOGSTOR TwinPipe-Rohre sind eine Rohr-in-Rohr-Baugruppe mit einer Verbundstruktur bestehend aus:
- zwei Stahl-Mediumrohre oder Stahl-Kompensator,
- Wärmedämmung aus Polyurethan-Hartschaum (PUR) mit poröser Struktur, hellgelber Farbe, geschäumt unter Verwendung von Cyclopentan,
- Außenmantel aus Polyethylen (PE-HD), direkt im kontinuierlichen Produktionsprozess von vorisolierten Rohren hergestellt oder aus einem in einem separaten Produktionsprozess hergestellten Rohr, schwarz (mit oder ohne Diffusionssperrschicht).
„Axial Conti“-Methode – bei der die Wärmeisolierung des Rohrs in einer Prozesslinie durchgeführt wird (durch Aufbringen aufeinanderfolgender Schichten gemischter Schaumkomponenten auf das in einer beweglichen Form platzierte Trägerrohr) und die Schutzschicht auf die fertige Isolierung gepresst wird; Das Verfahren wird zur Herstellung von LOGSTOR-Rohren mit einem Manteldurchmesser von DC 90 ÷ 315 mm verwendet;

Scope: 
The declaration is for specific product - Preinsulated bonded TwinPipe 2x60.3/200- conti method. The declared product is produced by LOGSTOR Denmark Holding ApS in production plant in Lgstr, Denmark (DK). 
System boundary: 
The life cycle assessment addressees the life cycle of the pipe system from cradle to gate with options, modules C1-C4, and module D (A1-A3, C,D and additional modules. The additional modules include A4 and A5). The product stage comprises the modules A1 (raw material procurement), A2 (transport), A3 (production), A4 (delivery), A5 (assembly), C1 (dismantling), C2 (transport), C3 (waste treatment), C4 (disposal) and D (recycling potential) in accordance with /EN15804+A2/ including the provision of all materials, products and energy.

Production stage (A1-A3): Extraction, processing
and transport of raw materials (including steel pipes, PU foam, PE film, copper wire) used for the production of the pipe system. 
Delivery (A4): Transport of the the pipe system to the construction site by truck (assuming e.g. 100 km as a base value or an averaged distance)
Installation (A5): Manual installation of the the pipe system and the offcuts or auxiliary materials during installation are not considered.
Deconstruction (C1): Manual removal of the pipe system
Transport (C2): Transport of the dismantled pipe system for waste management by truck transport (50 km).
Waste treatment (C3): Waste treatment of the pipe system: 100% material recycling for the metal components of the pipe system (steel, copper and/or aluminium pipes) and 100% thermal utilisation of the plastic components of the pipe system in a waste incineration plant (MVA) with an R1 value > 0.6 with declaration of recovery potential in D from Energy substitution.
Disposal (C4): no further expenses due to Landfill/disposal.
Module D: Energy substitution and benefits from A5 and C3 are declared in module D.
